note: BH-9435: 1 (default) = the headroom step only writes its audit line to logs/disk-headroom.log (what it would trim and the MB) and deletes nothing. 0 = it trims: the subdirs of old settled build dirs go, the dir and its top-level files (RESULT, job.json, markers, artifacts) stay, so the build-archive readers still answer. Set 0 after one day of audit lines. Any value other than 0 is a dry run.
